versions.name: RXV2-0.9.419-esc-words
versions.notes: Clearer ESC wording after Malcolm went looking for Scorpion under ESC signal: the SIGNAL row now says heli ESCs (Scorpion, Kontronik, YGE, Hobbywing) use Normal PWM and DShot is for drone-style ESCs; the TELEMETRY row now says that is where the brand goes.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.418-complete-menu
versions.notes: A la carte is now the COMPLETE catalogue: Transmitter channels and First-time basics appear there too, so everything the wizards walk through can also be reached on its own. The Wizards menu stays clean with just the two guides.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.417-more-functions
versions.notes: Transmitter channels grows 'Add another function' - black box, beeper, self-level, governor overrides, user switches and more, each detectable by wiggle and written as a verified switch range. Two functions may share one switch; sticks and Arm may never be shared. The Wizards menu is now just the two guides - Transmitter channels and First-time basics live inside the New-helicopter wizard as its steps 3 and 4.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.416-wizard-steps
versions.notes: Transmitter channels and First-time basics moved to the Wizards page where they belong - they are the build wizard's two big steps, listed there for a straight jump. A la carte now holds only the individual tuning/setup pages.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.415-three-doors
versions.notes: The Rotorflight page is now just three doors (Malcolm's words): WIZARDS (new helicopter, tuning), A LA CARTE (straight to any single setting), and BACKUP & RESTORE on its own page. Every page is where it was - only the front door changed.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.414-tidy-hub
versions.notes: The Rotorflight page, tidied into three groups now that it has grown: STEP-BY-STEP GUIDES (New helicopter, Tuning), INDIVIDUAL SETTINGS (transmitter channels through PIDs, roughly in setup order), and BACKUP & RESTORE with its own heading. Nothing moved pages - just a calmer front door.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.413-mounting
versions.notes: First-time basics gains 'Which way round is it mounted?' - the only two real Nexus positions: connections to the FRONT (standard) or to the BACK (yaw 180, board_align_yaw). Set FIRST, above level calibration, since level depends on it; applies after the in-page FC restart. Odd angles are reported as custom (configurator territory). Verified writes as always.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.412-tx-first
versions.notes: Transmitter first! New wizard step + page: set the model up on your transmitter, then tell the wizard which channel is which - or tap Detect and wiggle each control (the receiver spots the moving channel). Saving writes the flight controller's channel order (rcmap) and puts Arm & Rescue on your chosen switches (Modes, 1600-2100us), all verified by read-back. Your layout is remembered as the default for the next helicopter.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.411-tuning-wizard
versions.notes: Second wizard: TUNING - the after-the-build field checklist, in the order that works: back up first, mechanics check in the hover, governor, tail, cyclic, rates/expo to taste, fine touches, prove Rescue up high, back up the proven tune. One change per flight; ticks per model, like the New-helicopter checklist.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.410-fleet-ticks
versions.notes: New-helicopter checklist is now PER MODEL: ticks are keyed by the receiver's name, so a whole fleet of new helicopters each starts its own fresh checklist ('Setting up: <name>' shown at the top).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.409-fw-note
versions.notes: New-helicopter checklist gains step 1: a note that a fresh flight controller already has Rotorflight on it (fine to fly), and that installing the very latest firmware first is a one-time USB job with the Rotorflight Configurator on a computer - flashing cannot be done from the phone. A desktop wizard that flashes too is planned.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.408-new-heli
versions.notes: The NEW HELICOPTER wizard begins: a step-by-step from-scratch setup checklist (blades off!) plus the new First-time basics page - level calibration (accelerometer), governor/telemetry/ESC-sensor features, ESC protocol + motor poles + gear ratios, ESC telemetry brand, battery cells/capacity/voltage sources, and one-tap standard channel order (AERCT123). All writes verified by read-back; restart-to-apply handled in-page.
